page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r8i.8xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance configured within the KVM hypervisor framework. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8475B processor running at a baseline frequency of 2.7 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 20 Gbps, facilitating steady data transfer rates for distributed environments. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density provide a stable resource profile for memory-bound workloads without the overhead of local storage maintenance.

Given its hardware configuration, the ecs.r8i.8xlarge is designed for memory-intensive applications. It is suitable for hosting medium-to-large relational databases, in-memory caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and data analytics pipelines that require substantial memory capacity relative to compute resources.
